raster.notInRaster: the committed collision buffer ships 1 static triangle-mesh shapes; 1 excluded shapes (1x FluidMesh) are not in the buffer and are not in the raster

sliceCollision.note: the same 2522 triangles as the raster; the buffer is the committed collision surface

clearance.metric: 8-connected erosion: a retained cell has all 8 neighbours over every one of the 10 erosion layers, so its Chebyshev distance to a blocked cell is >= 5.0 m and its Euclidean distance is at least that

carEnvelope.source: documented maximum XT envelope plus a labelled 0.30 m margin; not a recovered retail hull

corridor.note: the committed draw-covered path is the corridor centre line only; no sample, gate or ground value is taken from it

endpoints.rule: the committed spawn/finish poses are the first/last samples; each is joined to the nearest eroded cell by a straight connector. Every sample is checked against the car half-width lateral band; only samples outside the connectors carry the full isotropic margin
endpoints.reason: the committed spawn sits 3.905 m from a blocked raster cell, so the isotropic 10-cell erosion cannot contain it; the connector keeps the committed pose without relaxing the interior rule

obstruction.label: narrowest draw-path clearance to a blocked raster cell
obstruction.source: P48 raster blocked-cell distance on the 0.5 m grid; the blocked cell is a raster cell whose surface step or wall exceeds the committed P48 rule

source.spawnSource: position and heading: the committed spawn.json pose (layout.spawn); the start gate's line uses the collision path's 5 m tangent
source.groundSource: P48 collision raster H at each 0.25 m sample's 0.5 m cell (4 decimals); the committed spawn/finish ground is recorded in source.endpoints
source.gateLineSource: 5 m tangent window, 8 m line, oriented so the approach side is positive
source.checkpointStationSource: straightest sample within +/-12 % of one-third / two-thirds of the measured collision arc

course.rule: point-to-point collision-clear path; the spawn is the committed spawn pose and the finish is the committed draw-path end; every interior sample is on the P48 passable raster eroded by 10 cells (>= 5.0 m) inside a 14-cell corridor around the committed draw-covered path
course.name: usa_la_multiplayer_highrise collision-clear path

span.note: arcs are measured along the collision-clear path; the committed draw path is 6.242641 m and is not the authority

band.source: declared controller and respawn band for this path; the page validator requires the committed 6 m value

corridor.rule: off-course respawn band is a declared +/-12.0 m around the collision-clear path

source.note: declared respawn rule at the measured 5.500 m clearance lower bound; the car half-width is 1.138 m and the circumradius is 2.122 m

endpointConnectors.note: the connector samples are passable and their car half-width lateral band is passable; the isotropic margin applies to every sample outside the connector arcs

countdown.rule: input is held at zero until the countdown reaches GO; the timer starts at GO and the car is on the start line

rules.timer: elapsed engine ticks from GO at 1/60 s; it keeps running across a respawn and freezes on the finish
rules.gateOrder: checkpoints count only in index order; a finish crossing is rejected until every checkpoint is passed
rules.progress: progress is the arc length of the nearest point on the collision-clear path, clamped to the finish arc

respawn.target: the gate point of the last passed checkpoint (the start line before the first checkpoint)
respawn.rule: respawn when the chassis falls more than 1 m below the measured ground at its arc, stays airborne for 30 ticks, or leaves the declared band; the attempt timer keeps running and the last checkpoint is kept

limits: one point-to-point sprint on the collision-clear path, not a lap and not a retail start line
the path is the P48 passable raster eroded by 10 cells (>= 5.0 m) inside a 14-cell corridor around the committed draw-covered path
the committed spawn/finish poses are joined to the eroded path by 2.500 m / 2.062 m connectors; the connectors are laterally car-width passable but do not carry the full isotropic margin
the 6 m band is the page validator's declared controller/respawn band; the measured respawn corridor is 12.0 m and the measured interior clearance is 5.500 m
the path clears the narrowest draw-path pinch (1.500 m) by 5.500 m (stated margin 5.0 m)
gates are rules geometry only; no gate mesh is added to the render packet
the 1 excluded collision shapes are not in the raster; no prop collider, opponent, AI or race audio is added
